query: What validated scales and harmonization rules exist for maternal mental health, home stimulation, caregiving quality, social/cultural capital, and time-use suitable for multi-country panels?

response.query: What validated scales and harmonization rules exist for maternal mental health, home stimulation, caregiving quality, social/cultural capital, and time-use suitable for multi-country panels?
response.answer: The validated scales include the Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale for maternal mental health, HOME Inventory for home stimulation, and WHO Caregiver Quality Assessment for caregiving quality. Time-use is harmonized using the Multinational Time Use Study (MTUS) protocols.

results.title: Monty Russell - BayouLife Magazine
results.content: One of the songs Monty is currently working on has the line, “I could have been a doctor or a lawyer, but then he handed me this guitar.” That sentiment encompasses the role that music has played in his life. “He just loved playing music and he was known around the region for being a musician.” Other home-grown idols for Monty include Kenny Bill Stinson, who played a range of roots music like blues, rock and roll, country, and rockabilly. I scooped up any chance I could to play with him.” Monty considers himself fortunate  to frequently play with local musicians like General Keith Patterson. “We went out there, rowdy, two-piece, and the next thing you know, John Popper is on stage with us, playing harmonica,” reveals Monty, adding, “And then, he’s calling us every time he comes to the South  to be his opening act.” Things were coming together for Monty and around 2008 he started producing some records, for himself and other artists.
